name: Garlic Butter Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Season chicken with salt and pepper, add to pan, cook 6-7 minutes per side. Garnish with parsley.

name: Mediterranean Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil salted water, cook pasta 10 minutes. Wash tomatoes, slice olives, tear basil. Combine tomatoes and basil with olive oil. Drain pasta, cool. Toss everything with mozzarella and tuna. Rest 30 minutes.

name: Simple Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in wok. Scramble eggs, remove. Add garlic, then rice. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add soy sauce, eggs, green onions. Serve hot.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add chopped tomatoes and stock. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Stir in basil before serving.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Heat oil in wok. Cook chicken until golden, remove. Stir-fry vegetables 3 minutes. Add ginger, garlic, soy sauce. Return chicken, toss, serve.

name: Cheesy Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a non-stick pan. Pour in eggs, cook until almost set. Add cheese, fold in half. Serve immediately.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Whisk in milk and eggs. Melt butter in pan. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, flip, cook 1 minute.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add cumin and paprika. Warm taco shells. Fill with beef, top with cheese and lettuce.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add canned tomatoes, simmer 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti al dente. Serve sauce over pasta, top with basil.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill chicken and slice. Toss lettuce with dressing. Add chicken, croutons, and parmesan. Serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add curry powder and vegetables. Pour coconut milk, simmer 20 minutes until tender. Serve with rice.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread on outside. Place cheese between slices. Grill in pan until golden on both sides, cheese melted.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic. Add tomatoes and spices, simmer 10 minutes. Make wells, crack eggs in. Cover and cook until whites are set.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef in batches. Sauté onion and garlic. Add flour, stock, tomato paste. Simmer 90 minutes. Add vegetables, cook 30 more minutes.

name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add rice, toast 1 minute. Add wine, stir until absorbed. Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring. Stir in mushrooms, butter, parmesan.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken in stock 20 minutes. Remove and shred. Add vegetables, cook 10 minutes. Add noodles, cook 5 minutes. Return chicken, garnish with parsley.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, water, salt into dough. Rest 1 hour. Top with tomatoes, mozzarella. Bake 250C for 10 minutes. Add basil and olive oil.

name: Beef Burger
instructions: Form beef into patties, season. Grill 4 minutes per side. Toast buns. Assemble with cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, ketchup.

name: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak noodles 20 minutes. Stir-fry shrimp, remove. Scramble eggs. Add noodles, soy sauce, shrimp. Toss with sprouts, peanuts, lime.

name: French Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar. Dip bread in mixture. Melt butter in pan. Cook bread 2 minutes per side. Serve with syrup.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes. Layer alternating on plate. Add basil leaves. Drizzle olive oil, season with salt and pepper.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add curry powder and chicken, brown. Add tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes. Add coconut milk, cook 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in wok. Scramble eggs, remove. Add garlic, rice, vegetables. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add soy sauce, eggs, green onions.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, onion. Combine with olives. Crumble feta on top. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil peeled potatoes until tender, 20 minutes. Drain, mash. Add butter and milk, mash until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Mix in flour and baking soda. Fold in chips. Bake at 180C for 10-12 minutes.

name: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with melted butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla. Fold in dry ingredients. Pour into loaf pan, bake 180C for 55 minutes.

name: Tuna Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté garlic and chili in oil. Add tomatoes, simmer 5 minutes. Add tuna and pasta, toss. Garnish with parsley.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Cook diced chicken with cumin and vegetables. Place chicken and cheese on half a tortilla. Fold over. Grill in pan until golden on both sides.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes. Add cream and parmesan. Toss with cooked pasta and basil.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, honey in jar. Refrigerate overnight. Top with banana and berries before serving.

name: Beef Stir Fry
instructions: Slice beef thin. Marinate in soy sauce 10 minutes. Stir-fry beef, remove. Stir-fry vegetables, add ginger and garlic. Return beef, serve over rice.

name: Hummus
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice. Add water to reach smooth texture. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle cumin.

name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Cut potatoes into chips, fry 5 minutes, drain. Mix flour and beer into batter. Dip fish, fry until golden. Serve with chips.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic. Add potatoes, tomatoes, stock, thyme. Simmer 30 minutes. Season and serve.

name: Chicken Wings
instructions: Marinate wings in soy, honey, garlic, ginger 30 minutes. Bake at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once. Sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Boil eggs 10 minutes, cool, peel, chop. Mix with mayo, mustard, green onion, salt, pepper. Spread on bread, close sandwiches.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic. Add lentils, stock, cumin. Simmer 30 minutes until lentils tender. Blend partially for creamy texture.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix peanut butter, sugar, egg. Add flour, baking soda, vanilla. Roll into balls, press with fork. Bake 180C for 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Sauté chicken with spices. Add vegetables, cook 5 minutes. Squeeze lime. Serve in warm tortillas.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil. Add garlic, rice, vegetables. Stir-fry 4 minutes. Add soy sauce. Garnish with green onions.

name: Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, parmesan, garlic, parsley. Roll into balls. Brown in pan. Simmer in tomato sauce 20 minutes.

name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon, salt, pepper. Spread on toast. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle chili flakes.

name: Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Chop vegetables into chunks. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, thyme. Roast at 200C for 30 minutes, stirring halfway.

name: Chili con Carne
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add spices. Add tomatoes and beans. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve with rice or bread.

name: Tuna Melt
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo and onion. Butter bread. Place tuna and cheese between slices. Grill until golden.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken with spices, shred. Roll in tortillas with cheese. Top with tomato sauce and cheese. Bake 180C for 20 minutes.

name: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and parsley. Slice bread, spread mixture. Bake 200C for 10 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine. Sauté chicken in butter, remove. Add garlic, cream, parmesan. Toss with pasta and chicken. Garnish with parsley.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Sauté vegetables in butter. Whisk eggs, pour over. Cook until set. Add cheese, fold. Serve hot.

name: Beef Burrito
instructions: Cook beef with cumin. Layer rice, beans, beef, cheese, salsa on tortilla. Roll tightly. Grill 2 minutes per side.

name: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add cauliflower and stock. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend, add cream and nutmeg.

name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Cook bacon and diced potatoes. Scramble eggs. Warm tortillas. Fill with eggs, bacon, potatoes, cheese, salsa. Roll and serve.

name: Baked Salmon
instructions: Place salmon on baking sheet. Drizzle oil, add garlic, lemon slices. Bake 200C for 15 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic, oil into pesto. Cook pasta. Toss hot pasta with pesto. Serve with extra parmesan.

name: Chicken Soup
instructions: Place chicken in pot with water, stock, vegetables. Simmer 2 hours. Remove chicken, shred. Return to pot with herbs. Serve hot.

name: Veggie Burger
instructions: Mash beans with onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, cumin. Form patties. Pan-fry 4 minutes per side. Serve on buns with lettuce and tomato.

name: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook linguine. Sauté garlic and chili in butter. Add shrimp, cook 2 minutes. Add wine, lemon juice. Toss with pasta, parsley.

name: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Whisk in sugar, eggs, vanilla. Fold in flour, cocoa, salt. Bake 180C for 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cook rice with onion, garlic, tomatoes. Mix with cheese and parsley. Fill peppers. Bake 180C for 30 minutes.
